# atomic_update FILE JQ-ARGS... — jq over FILE (or {} when FILE is absent) →
# FILE.tmp.$$ → mv -f, under flock on FILE.lock. Exit 3 on any failure; the
# previous file is untouched.
atomic_update() {
  local f="$1"; shift
  local tmp="$f.tmp.$$" rc=0
  (
    # flock is util-linux (Linux); without it (macOS) the write is still atomic
    # (tmp + mv) but concurrent writers may interleave — last writer wins.
    if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then flock -w 5 9 || { echo "run-checkpoint: lock timeout on $f.lock" >&2; exit 3; }; fi
    if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
      jq "$@" "$f" > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: $f is not valid JSON — not written" >&2; exit 3; }
    else
      jq "$@" <<<'{}' > "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: could not build $f" >&2; exit 3; }
    fi
    jq -e . "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f -- "$tmp"; echo "run-checkpoint: refusing to replace $f with unparseable output" >&2; exit 3; }
    mv -f -- "$tmp" "$f"
  ) 9>"$f.lock" || rc=$?
  return $rc
}

      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
  done <<<"$rows"

  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
  rounds="[]"
  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
  fi
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")

  local facts report
  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
    {sprints: $s,
     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
       notes: ([
         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
       ]),
       sprints: $f.sprints,
       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
       written: false}')

  if (( write )); then
    local why=""
    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
    fi
    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
    else
      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
    fi
  fi

  if (( json )); then
    jq . <<<"$report"
  else
    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
  fi
  return 0
}

cmd_record_round() {
  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
  local p th ts now out trip
  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
    return 0
  fi
  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
        else null end ) as $trip
    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.thresh
  echo "$out"
  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
    return 10
  fi
  return 0
}

cmd_mark() {
  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    local err drc=0
    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
  fi
  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
}

case "$sub" in
  write)  cmd_write ;;
  read)   cmd_read ;;
  derive) cmd_derive ;;
  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;
  mark)   cmd_mark ;;
  unmark) rm -f -- "$run_dir/implement-active.json" "$run_dir/implement-active.json.lock"; echo "unmarked" ;;
  *) usage ;;
esac

tool_use_result.stdout:
| (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
      else null end ) as $trip
  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
def resolve($f; $now; $win):
  . as $c
  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
'

cmd_derive() {
  local ledger="$root/grimoires/loa/ledger.json" a2a="$root/grimoires/loa/a2a" active rows
  if [[ ! -f "$ledger" ]] || ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: no readable ledger at $ledger — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
  fi
  active=$(jq -r '.active_cycle // empty | strings' "$ledger")
  if [[ -z "$active" ]] || ! jq -e --arg c "$active" 'any(.cycles[]?; .id == $c)' "$ledger" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: the ledger has no active cycle — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4
  fi
  local win now now_ts fa=1 th
  win=$(( $(cfg_int '.run_mode.stale_hours' 12 8760) * 3600 ))
  [[ "$(cfg '.run_mode.file_authoritative')" == false ]] && fa=0
  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
  now=$(date +%s); now_ts=$(now_iso)

  # Per-sprint facts
  local sprints="[]" gid label lstatus since dir rv au mex msid ic sj
  rows=$(jq -r --arg c "$active" '
    (.cycles[] | select(.id == $c)) as $cy
    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))
        | if length == 0 then "" else ([.[0], ($cy.created // "")] | max) end)]
    | map(if . == "" then "-" else . end)
    | @tsv' "$ledger")
  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
    mex=false; msid=""
    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
      mex=true
      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
    fi
    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
  done <<<"$rows"

  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
  rounds="[]"
  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
  fi
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")

  local facts report
  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
    {sprints: $s,
     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
       notes: ([
         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
       ]),
       sprints: $f.sprints,
       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
       written: false}')

  if (( write )); then
    local why=""
    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
    fi
    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
    else
      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
    fi
  fi

  if (( json )); then
    jq . <<<"$report"
  else
    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
  fi
  return 0
}

cmd_record_round() {
  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
  local p th ts now out trip
  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
    return 0
  fi
  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
        else null end ) as $trip
    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.thresh
  echo "$out"
  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
    return 10
  fi
  return 0
}

cmd_mark() {
  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
    local err drc=0
    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
  fi
  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
}

case "$sub" in
  write)  cmd_write ;;
  read)   cmd_read ;;
  derive) cmd_derive ;;
  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;
  mark)   cmd_mark ;;
  unmark) rm -f -- "$run_dir/implement-active.json" "$run_dir/implement-active.json.lock"; echo "unmarked" ;;
  *) usage ;;
esac

    11	#        the key set explicitly in the config (an explicit `false` counts —
    12	#        never `// default`, which reads false as absent), else the selected
    13	#        profile's value when the key is a profile key, else <fallback>.
    14	#        Returns 2 (printing the fallback) on a malformed path.
    15	#   loa_profile_overrides           → `key=value` lines, one per explicit
    16	#        profile key whose value differs from the selected profile's value
    17	#   loa_effective_json              → the resolved document (below)
    18	#
    19	# CLI: profile-lib.sh profile | source | knob <path> <fallback> | overrides | json

    27	#
    28	# Cache: <root>/.run/effective-config.json (LOA_PROFILE_CACHE_FILE overrides),
    29	# keyed on the paths and the mtime+size of the config, profiles.yaml and
    30	# floor.yaml: any edit to one of them rebuilds it on the next call, so it is
    31	# built once per session in practice. When the config is a seam (not the
    32	# repository's own file) and no cache seam is set, nothing is cached — a test
    33	# config never overwrites the repository's cache. The warm path is one stat
    34	# and one jq. The write is atomic (temp file + mv in the same directory).
    35	#
    36	# Safety: a profile key that names a floor key (floor.yaml `floor_keys`, `*`

    38	# ignored with a WARN — no profile can reach the floor. Key paths are checked

    42	
    43	_LOA_PL_SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"

    50	_loa_pl_paths() {

   297	if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
   298	  export LC_ALL=C
   299	  case "${1:-}" in

   104	# Byte sequences strip_controls removes: UTF-8 C1 controls (C2 80..C2 9F) and the format/bidi code points
   105	# U+200B-U+200F, U+2028-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+206F, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+061C, U+180E, U+FE00-U+FE0F,
   106	# U+FFF9-U+FFFB and the tag characters U+E0001, U+E0020-U+E007F (run-3 finding 5); each sequence starts with a lead
   107	# byte, so a byte-wise match never lands inside another character
   108	# printf -v keeps this portable (no GNU-sed \x); built on first use, not on every Write/Edit (BB-008)
   109	_IG_STRIP_SEQS=()
   110	_ig_strip_seqs_init() {
   111	    local _ig_i _ig_hex _ig_seq
   112	    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 160; _ig_i++ )); do
   113	        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xc2\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   114	    done
   115	    for _ig_hex in 8b 8c 8d 8e 8f a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae; do
   116	        printf -v _ig_seq "\\xe2\\x80\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   117	    done
   118	    for _ig_hex in a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a6 a7 a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae af; do
   119	        printf -v _ig_seq "\\xe2\\x81\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   120	    done
   121	    for _ig_seq in '\xef\xbb\xbf' '\xc2\xad' '\xd8\x9c' '\xe1\xa0\x8e' '\xef\xbf\xb9' '\xef\xbf\xba' '\xef\xbf\xbb' '\xf3\xa0\x80\x81'; do
   122	        printf -v _ig_seq "$_ig_seq"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   123	    done
   124	    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 144; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+FE00-U+FE0F = EF B8 80..EF B8 8F
   125	        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xef\\xb8\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   126	    done
   127	    for (( _ig_i = 160; _ig_i < 192; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+E0020-U+E003F = F3 A0 80 A0..F3 A0 80 BF
   128	        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xf3\\xa0\\x80\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   129	    done
   130	    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 192; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+E0040-U+E007F = F3 A0 81 80..F3 A0 81 BF
   131	        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xf3\\xa0\\x81\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
   132	    done
   133	}

   135	# Sets the variable named $1 to at most 256 bytes of $2, never ending inside a UTF-8 character: a trailing lead byte
   136	# whose sequence the cut left short, or stray continuation bytes, are dropped (run-3 finding 5; jq would read a split
   137	# character as U+FFFD). printf -v, not $(...), so a trailing newline in a raw value survives into the audit row
   138	cut_utf8_256() {
   139	    local LC_ALL=C
   140	    local _c_s=${2:0:256} _c_n _c_i _c_b _c_need
   141	    _c_n=${#_c_s}
   142	    for (( _c_i = _c_n - 1; _c_i >= 0 && _c_i >= _c_n - 4; _c_i-- )); do
   143	        printf -v _c_b '%d' "'${_c_s:_c_i:1}"
   144	        (( _c_b >= 128 && _c_b < 192 )) && continue   # continuation byte: keep walking back to its lead
   145	        if (( _c_b < 128 )); then _c_need=1; elif (( _c_b < 224 )); then _c_need=2; elif (( _c_b < 240 )); then _c_need=3; else _c_need=4; fi
   146	        if (( _c_n - _c_i < _c_need )); then _c_s=${_c_s:0:_c_i}          # the cut left this character short
   147	        elif (( _c_n - _c_i > _c_need )); then _c_s=${_c_s:0:_c_i+_c_need}   # continuation bytes after a complete character are stray
   148	        fi
   149	        printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_c_s"
   150	        return 0
   151	    done
   152	    printf -v "$1" '%s' "${_c_s:0:_c_i+1}"   # only continuation bytes at the end: drop them
   153	}

   155	# Display copy of a model-authored string: cut to 256 bytes first (the fixed point below then costs at most a few
   156	# passes over a short string), then C0 and DEL, then the sequences above byte-wise until nothing changes (deleting
   157	# one sequence can join its neighbours into another: C2 C2 9B 9B)
   158	strip_controls() {
   159	    local LC_ALL=C s prev seq
   160	    cut_utf8_256 s "$1"
   161	    s=$(printf '%s' "$s" | tr -d '\000-\037\177')

   165	        for seq in "${_IG_STRIP_SEQS[@]}"; do s=${s//"$seq"/}; done
   166	        [[ "$s" == "$prev" ]] && break
   167	    done
   168	    printf '%s' "$s"
   169	}

   259	# T4.5: Path normalization — canonicalise both sides, then take file_path
   260	# relative to the project root (run-2 finding 1). A textual prefix test let
   261	# /proc/self/cwd/src/x, //ROOT/src/x, ROOT/../<name>/src/x or a symlinked root
   262	# reach an App-Zone file unseen. Two forms are tested and either one matching
   263	# counts (run-3 finding 1): the PHYSICAL form follows symlinks (realpath -m,
   264	# else readlink -f) against pwd -P of the root; the LOGICAL form keeps them
   265	# (realpath -m -s, else a pure-bash ./../// normaliser) against pwd -L, so a
   266	# src/ that is itself a symlink out of the root still asks. A relative path
   267	# resolves from the payload's cwd when it carries one (the harness resolves it
   268	# there and cwd follows `cd` in the Bash tool), else from PROJECT_ROOT (run-3
   269	# finding 6). Only the part under the root is matched, so parent directory
   270	# names never count (e.g., /home/user/src-projects/loa/grimoires/file.md is not src/*).
   271	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   272	# Lexical normaliser for an absolute path: drops empty and . components, resolves .. textually, follows no symlink
   273	_ig_lexical_norm() {
   274	    local rest=$1 part
   275	    local -a out=()
   276	    while [[ -n "$rest" ]]; do
   277	        part=${rest%%/*}
   278	        if [[ "$rest" == */* ]]; then rest=${rest#*/}; else rest=""; fi
   279	        case "$part" in
   280	            ''|.) ;;
   281	            ..) (( ${#out[@]} )) && unset 'out[${#out[@]}-1]' ;;
   282	            *) out+=("$part") ;;
   283	        esac
   284	    done
   285	    local IFS=/
   286	    printf '/%s' "${out[*]}"
   287	}

   289	# $1 relative to the root $2, or failure when $1 is not under $2
   290	_ig_under_root() {

   292	    printf '%s' "${1#"${2%/}"/}"
   293	}

#   override          — LOA_IMPLEMENT_GATE_OVERRIDE=1 in the hook's environment
# Rows go to .run/audit.jsonl as {ts, hook: "implement-gate", action, decision,
# mode, path} with path control-stripped and cut to 256 bytes; LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
# adds replay: true to every row this gate writes (DEC-0167).
#
# Claims modifier (implement_gate.claims: authoritative; the legacy
# implement_gate.mode: authoritative means mode ask + claims authoritative):
#   reads tool_input.active_skill from hook stdin. The PreToolUse
#      payload carries no harness-set skill field (cycle-126 D-4.4) and tool_input
#      is model-authored, so nothing in .run/ selects this modifier.
#      TIGHTEN-ONLY (sprint-250 audit n17/n18): the model-authored claim can only
#      add an ask, never grant an allow. A claimed implementation skill falls
#      through to the heuristic exactly like an absent field; a claimed
#      non-implementation skill asks (or, under deny with a known position and no
#      sanction, is denied) and logs compliance.mode.model_signal to
#      .run/audit.jsonl (plain hook log, not the signed audit_emit chain). Every
#      claim leaves one row per invocation: decision "ask"/"deny" for a non-implementation
#      claim, decision "heuristic" for an implementation claim (run-2 finding 6).
#
# `implement-gate.sh --effective-mode [CONFIG]` prints the effective mode (and the
# claims modifier) without reading stdin — the /loa Gate line.
#
# Evidence recorder (cycle-126 D-4.4): a lead-session payload carrying
# tool_input.active_skill records active_skill_seen_at once in
# .run/platform-features.json. It is evidence only and never changes the mode.
#
# Failure mode: FAIL-ASK for App Zone writes (not fail-open). A payload jq cannot
# parse (or no jq), or a file_path that cannot be canonicalised, asks too (run-2
# findings 1/5). The path is tool_input.file_path, or tool_input.notebook_path for
# NotebookEdit; a relative path resolves from the payload's cwd, else PROJECT_ROOT
# (run-3 finding 6). The zone test ORs a physical form (symlinks followed) and a
# logical form (symlinks kept) and matches a lowercased copy (run-3 findings 1/2).
# Root: PROJECT_ROOT, else CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, else this script's location
# (<root>/.claude/hooks/compliance/), never the process cwd, which follows
# Claude's `cd` (audit MED-001); RUN_DIR defaults to <root>/.run.
# Trust inputs: a write to .run/state.json, .run/sprint-plan-state.json,
# .run/simstim-state.json, .run/platform-features.json, .run/audit.jsonl,
# .run/implement-active.json or .loa.config.yaml asks in every mode and under
# every sanction, and logs compliance.state_write (run-3 finding 3).
# Other non-App-Zone writes always allowed.
#
# Output (Claude Code PreToolUse contract, sprint-250 audit n20): allow = silent
# exit 0 with empty stdout; ask = exit 0 with
#   {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"…"}}
# deny = the same shape with "permissionDecision":"deny".
# A top-level "decision" accepts approve|block only, so "ask" never goes there.
# file_path and active_skill reach stderr only through strip_controls (n21;
# run-2 findings 3/12; run-3 finding 5): cut to 256 bytes without splitting a
# character, then C0 and DEL, UTF-8 C1 controls and the Unicode format/bidi/tag
# code points are removed to a fixed point. Audit rows record the RAW values cut
# the same way and written with jq -a, so every non-ASCII code point is \uXXXX:
# faithful (implement+U+200B logs as implement\u200b) and terminal-safe (run-3 finding 4).
#
# IMPORTANT: No set -euo pipefail — hook must never crash-block.
# Parse/read errors on App Zone writes → ask (not allow).
#
# Part of cycle-049/050: Upstream Platform Alignment (FR-7)
# Red Team findings addressed: ATK-005 (state tampering), ATK-006 (fail-open),
#   ATK-007 (prompt injection via file path)
# Sprint-108 T4.4: Dual-mode (authoritative + heuristic)
# Sprint-108 T4.5: Path normalization
# =============================================================================

# Read tool input from stdin (not for --effective-mode, which reads no payload)
input=""
if [[ "${1:-}" != "--effective-mode" ]]; then
    input=$(cat 2>/dev/null) || input=""
fi

# The ask reply; jq builds it so any reason is a well-formed JSON string (run-3 finding 7); the printf literal is only
# for the jq-missing branch, whose reason is a fixed string
emit_ask() {
    if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        jq -nc --arg r "$1" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'
    else
        printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}\n' "$1"
    fi
}

# Byte sequences strip_controls removes: UTF-8 C1 controls (C2 80..C2 9F) and the format/bidi code points
# U+200B-U+200F, U+2028-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+206F, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+061C, U+180E, U+FE00-U+FE0F,
# U+FFF9-U+FFFB and the tag characters U+E0001, U+E0020-U+E007F (run-3 finding 5); each sequence starts with a lead
# byte, so a byte-wise match never lands inside another character
# printf -v keeps this portable (no GNU-sed \x); built on first use, not on every Write/Edit (BB-008)
_IG_STRIP_SEQS=()
_ig_strip_seqs_init() {
    local _ig_i _ig_hex _ig_seq
    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 160; _ig_i++ )); do
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xc2\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for _ig_hex in 8b 8c 8d 8e 8f a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae; do
        printf -v _ig_seq "\\xe2\\x80\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for _ig_hex in a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a6 a7 a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae af; do
        printf -v _ig_seq "\\xe2\\x81\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for _ig_seq in '\xef\xbb\xbf' '\xc2\xad' '\xd8\x9c' '\xe1\xa0\x8e' '\xef\xbf\xb9' '\xef\xbf\xba' '\xef\xbf\xbb' '\xf3\xa0\x80\x81'; do
        printf -v _ig_seq "$_ig_seq"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 144; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+FE00-U+FE0F = EF B8 80..EF B8 8F
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xef\\xb8\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for (( _ig_i = 160; _ig_i < 192; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+E0020-U+E003F = F3 A0 80 A0..F3 A0 80 BF
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xf3\\xa0\\x80\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 192; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+E0040-U+E007F = F3 A0 81 80..F3 A0 81 BF
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xf3\\xa0\\x81\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
}

# Sets the variable named $1 to at most 256 bytes of $2, never ending inside a UTF-8 character: a trailing lead byte
# whose sequence the cut left short, or stray continuation bytes, are dropped (run-3 finding 5; jq would read a split
# character as U+FFFD). printf -v, not $(...), so a trailing newline in a raw value survives into the audit row
cut_utf8_256() {
    local LC_ALL=C
    local _c_s=${2:0:256} _c_n _c_i _c_b _c_need
    _c_n=${#_c_s}
    for (( _c_i = _c_n - 1; _c_i >= 0 && _c_i >= _c_n - 4; _c_i-- )); do
        printf -v _c_b '%d' "'${_c_s:_c_i:1}"
        (( _c_b >= 128 && _c_b < 192 )) && continue   # continuation byte: keep walking back to its lead
        if (( _c_b < 128 )); then _c_need=1; elif (( _c_b < 224 )); then _c_need=2; elif (( _c_b < 240 )); then _c_need=3; else _c_need=4; fi
        if (( _c_n - _c_i < _c_need )); then _c_s=${_c_s:0:_c_i}          # the cut left this character short
        elif (( _c_n - _c_i > _c_need )); then _c_s=${_c_s:0:_c_i+_c_need}   # continuation bytes after a complete character are stray
        fi
        printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_c_s"
        return 0
    done
    printf -v "$1" '%s' "${_c_s:0:_c_i+1}"   # only continuation bytes at the end: drop them
}

# Display copy of a model-authored string: cut to 256 bytes first (the fixed point below then costs at most a few
# passes over a short string), then C0 and DEL, then the sequences above byte-wise until nothing changes (deleting
# one sequence can join its neighbours into another: C2 C2 9B 9B)
strip_controls() {
    local LC_ALL=C s prev seq
    cut_utf8_256 s "$1"
    s=$(printf '%s' "$s" | tr -d '\000-\037\177')
    (( ${#_IG_STRIP_SEQS[@]} )) || _ig_strip_seqs_init
    while :; do
        prev=$s
        for seq in "${_IG_STRIP_SEQS[@]}"; do s=${s//"$seq"/}; done
        [[ "$s" == "$prev" ]] && break
    done
    printf '%s' "$s"
}

# The root never follows the process cwd, which follows Claude's `cd` (sprint-250 audit MED-001): PROJECT_ROOT, then
# the harness's CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (it stays at the session's project root), then this script's own location
# (<root>/.claude/hooks/compliance/)
PROJECT_ROOT="${PROJECT_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)}}"
RUN_DIR="${RUN_DIR:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.run}"
FEATURES_FILE="$RUN_DIR/platform-features.json"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mode and claims (cycle-129 D-4.1): one yq call, read only when a decision
# needs it. Unset, unreadable or unknown values are ask; the legacy
# mode: authoritative is ask + claims: authoritative. run_mode.stale_hours
# bounds derived_at (positive integer, default 12).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
gate_mode="ask"
gate_claims="plain"
gate_stale_hours=12
load_gate_config() {
    local cfg="${1:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml}" raw m c s
    command -v yq &>/dev/null && command -v jq &>/dev/null && [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || return 0
    # mikefarah yq v4 first; the python yq wrapper (jq syntax, JSON out) second
    raw=$(yq -o json -I 0 '{"m": .implement_gate.mode, "c": .implement_gate.claims, "s": .run_mode.stale_hours}' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null) \
        || raw=$(yq -c '{"m": .implement_gate.mode, "c": .implement_gate.claims, "s": .run_mode.stale_hours}' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null) \
        || return 0
    m=$(jq -r '.m | strings' <<<"$raw" 2>/dev/null) || m=""
    c=$(jq -r '.c | strings' <<<"$raw" 2>/dev/null) || c=""
    s=$(jq -r '.s | numbers | tostring' <<<"$raw" 2>/dev/null) || s=""
    case "$m" in
        ask|telemetry|deny) gate_mode="$m" ;;
        authoritative) gate_claims="authoritative" ;;
    esac
    [[ "$c" == "authoritative" ]] && gate_claims="authoritative"
    if [[ "$s" =~ ^[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] && (( 10#$s > 0 && 10#$s <= 8760 )); then gate_stale_hours=$(( 10#$s )); fi
    return 0
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--effective-mode" ]]; then
    load_gate_config "${2:-}"
    if [[ "$gate_claims" == "authoritative" ]]; then echo "$gate_mode (claims: authoritative)"; else echo "$gate_mode"; fi
    exit 0
fi

# Row helpers: LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 marks every row this gate writes (DEC-0167)
_ig_replay_json='{}'
[[ "${LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY:-}" == "1" ]] && _ig_replay_json='{"replay":true}'

# Evidence recorder: lead session only (no teammate role, no subagent agent_id), once, atomic.
if [[ -z "${LOA_TEAM_MEMBER:-}" && -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] \
    && jq -e '(.tool_input.active_skill // "") != "" and (.agent_id // "") == ""' <<<"$input" >/dev/null 2>&1 \

if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null || ! jq -e . <<<"$input" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

fi
file_path=${file_path%x}

if [[ -z "$file_path" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Source compat-lib.sh for _date_to_epoch()
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd 2>/dev/null)" || SCRIPT_DIR=""
COMPAT_LIB="${SCRIPT_DIR}/../../scripts/compat-lib.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/compat-lib.sh
source "$COMPAT_LIB" 2>/dev/null || true

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# T4.5: Path normalization — canonicalise both sides, then take file_path
# relative to the project root (run-2 finding 1). A textual prefix test let
# /proc/self/cwd/src/x, //ROOT/src/x, ROOT/../<name>/src/x or a symlinked root
# reach an App-Zone file unseen. Two forms are tested and either one matching
# counts (run-3 finding 1): the PHYSICAL form follows symlinks (realpath -m,
# else readlink -f) against pwd -P of the root; the LOGICAL form keeps them
# (realpath -m -s, else a pure-bash ./../// normaliser) against pwd -L, so a
# src/ that is itself a symlink out of the root still asks. A relative path
# resolves from the payload's cwd when it carries one (the harness resolves it
# there and cwd follows `cd` in the Bash tool), else from PROJECT_ROOT (run-3
# finding 6). Only the part under the root is matched, so parent directory
# names never count (e.g., /home/user/src-projects/loa/grimoires/file.md is not src/*).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lexical normaliser for an absolute path: drops empty and . components, resolves .. textually, follows no symlink
_ig_lexical_norm() {
    local rest=$1 part
    local -a out=()
    while [[ -n "$rest" ]]; do
        part=${rest%%/*}
        if [[ "$rest" == */* ]]; then rest=${rest#*/}; else rest=""; fi
        case "$part" in
            ''|.) ;;
            ..) (( ${#out[@]} )) && unset 'out[${#out[@]}-1]' ;;
            *) out+=("$part") ;;
        esac
    done
    local IFS=/
    printf '/%s' "${out[*]}"
}

# $1 relative to the root $2, or failure when $1 is not under $2
_ig_under_root() {
    [[ "$1" == "${2%/}/"* ]] || return 1
    printf '%s' "${1#"${2%/}"/}"
}

canonical_root=$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || canonical_root=""
logical_root=$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd -L) || logical_root=""
payload_cwd=$(jq -r '.cwd // empty | strings' <<<"$input" 2>/dev/null) || payload_cwd=""
if [[ "$file_path" == /* ]]; then
    abs_path=$file_path
else
    base_dir=${payload_cwd:-$logical_root}
    [[ "$base_dir" == /* ]] || base_dir="$logical_root/$base_dir"
    abs_path="${base_dir%/}/$file_path"
fi
canonical_path=""
logical_path=""
if [[ -n "$canonical_root" && -n "$logical_root" ]]; then
    # GNU realpath -m first (no component needs to exist), then readlink -f
    canonical_path=$(cd "$PROJECT_ROOT" 2>/dev/null \
        && { realpath -m -- "$abs_path" 2>/dev/null || readlink -f -- "$abs_path" 2>/dev/null; }) || canonical_path=""
    logical_path=$(realpath -m -s -- "$abs_path" 2>/dev/null) || logical_path=""
    [[ "$logical_path" == /* ]] || logical_path=$(_ig_lexical_norm "$abs_path")
fi
if [[ -z "$canonical_root" || -z "$canonical_path" ]]; then
    echo "[GATE] could not canonicalise tool_input.file_path; asking." >&2
    emit_ask "[GATE] could not canonicalise tool_input.file_path. Verify this write is intentional."
    exit 0
fi

# The root-relative forms, lowercased: on a case-insensitive filesystem (macOS default, ext4 casefold) Src/ is src/,
# and on a case-sensitive one this only adds asks for a directory literally named Src/ — tighten-only (run-3 finding 2)
# bash 3.2 has no lowercase parameter expansion (BB-001: a bad substitution there left rel_forms empty and the hook exited 0); LC_ALL=C so a
# BSD tr never stops at a byte that is not valid UTF-8 ("Illegal byte sequence") — the patterns are ASCII
_ig_lower() { printf '%s' "$1" | LC_ALL=C tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'; }

cut_utf8_256 audit_file_path "$file_path"
